.github/workflows/matrix-nlu-evidence-ex.content:
name: Matrix-NLU Evidence Extract

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pipeline/student-4-evidence.trigger'

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  extract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Read immutable source run
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SOURCE_RUN=$(sed -n 's/^source_run=//p' pipeline/student-4-evidence.trigger)
          test -n "$SOURCE_RUN"
          echo "SOURCE_RUN=$SOURCE_RUN" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Download preserved one-click evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p recovered
          gh run download "$SOURCE_RUN" \
            --name "matrix-nlu-one-click-$SOURCE_RUN" --dir recovered
      - name: Split report and deployable bundle
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p split/report split/bundle/training-student-4
          cp -a recovered/automation split/report/
          cp -a recovered/verification-training-student-4 split/report/
          cp recovered/training-student-4/training-result.json split/report/
          cp recovered/training-student-4/labels.json split/report/
          cp recovered/training-student-4/training-progress.json split/report/
          cp recovered/training-student-4/training-result.json split/bundle/training-student-4/
          cp recovered/training-student-4/labels.json split/bundle/training-student-4/
          cp recovered/training-student-4/model-state.pt split/bundle/training-student-4/
          cp -a recovered/training-student-4/tokenizer split/bundle/training-student-4/
          printf 'sourceRun=%s\nsourceArtifact=matrix-nlu-one-click-%s\n' \
            "$SOURCE_RUN" "$SOURCE_RUN" | tee split/report/source.txt split/bundle/source.txt
          find split/report -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > split/report/SHA256SUMS
          find split/bundle -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > split/bundle/SHA256SUMS
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: matrix-nlu-report-${{ env.SOURCE_RUN }}
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 6
          path: split/report/
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: matrix-nlu-bundle-${{ env.SOURCE_RUN }}
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 1
          path: split/bundle/

.github/workflows/matrix-nlu-post-train..content:
name: Matrix-NLU Post-Training Gates

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['Matrix-NLU Training']
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      training_run_id:
        description: Successful Matrix-NLU Training run id
        required: true
        type: string
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pipeline/teacher-post.trigger'

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  dev-calibration-frozen-export:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      HF_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY: '1'
      TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM: 'false'
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: '4'
      MKL_NUM_THREADS: '4'
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: matrix_nlu/requirements-train.txt
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .cache/huggingface
          key: matrix-nlu-geotrend-36de33ec-v1
      - name: Resolve and download immutable training evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_run" ]]; then
            SOURCE_RUN="${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}"
          elif [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "push" ]]; then
            SOURCE_RUN=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < pipeline/teacher-post.trigger)
          else
            SOURCE_RUN="${{ inputs.training_run_id }}"
          fi
          echo "SOURCE_TRAINING_RUN=$SOURCE_RUN" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          gh run download "$SOURCE_RUN" --name matrix-nlu-teacher-evidence --dir downloaded
          RESULT=$(find downloaded -type f -name training-result.json -print -quit)
          test -n "$RESULT"
          BUNDLE=$(dirname "$RESULT")
          echo "TRAINING_BUNDLE=$BUNDLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          sha256sum "$BUNDLE"/training-result.json "$BUNDLE"/model-state.pt "$BUNDLE"/labels.json
      - name: Install pinned evaluation and export dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --requirement matrix_nlu/requirements-train.txt
      - name: Run strict dev, frozen, ONNX and package gates
        run: >-
          python auto_test.py
          --bundle "$TRAINING_BUNDLE"
          --output-dir build/matrix-nlu/post-train
          --candidate-role teacher
          --onnx-repetitions 30
      - name: Record resource and source-run evidence
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/matrix-nlu/post-train
          printf 'SOURCE_TRAINING_RUN=%s\n' "${SOURCE_TRAINING_RUN:-UNRESOLVED}" | tee build/matrix-nlu/post-train/source-run.txt
          df -h .
          free -h
          find build/matrix-nlu/post-train -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > build/matrix-nlu/post-train/SHA256SUMS
          cp -f build/matrix-nlu/automation/auto-test-status.json build/matrix-nlu/post-train/auto-test-status.json 2>/dev/null || true
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: matrix-nlu-post-training-gates
          retention-days: 30
          path: build/matrix-nlu/post-train/

.github/workflows/matrix-nlu-student-4-v.content:
name: Matrix-NLU Student-4 V2 Hardened Gates

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      training_run_id:
        description: Completed Student-4-v2 training run id
        required: true
        type: string
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pipeline/student-4-v2-post.trigger'

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  dev-frozen-export-package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      HF_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY: '1'
      TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM: 'false'
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: '4'
      MKL_NUM_THREADS: '4'
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: matrix_nlu/requirements-train.txt
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .cache/huggingface
          key: matrix-nlu-geotrend-36de33ec-v2
      - name: Resolve immutable Student-4-v2 training bundle
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "push" ]]; then
            SOURCE_RUN=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < pipeline/student-4-v2-post.trigger)
          else
            SOURCE_RUN="${{ inputs.training_run_id }}"
          fi
          [[ "$SOURCE_RUN" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
          echo "SOURCE_TRAINING_RUN=$SOURCE_RUN" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          if ! gh run download "$SOURCE_RUN" --name "matrix-nlu-student-4-v2-bundle-$SOURCE_RUN" \
            --dir downloaded; then
            gh run download "$SOURCE_RUN" --name "matrix-nlu-bundle-$SOURCE_RUN" --dir downloaded
          fi
          RESULT=$(find downloaded -type f -name training-result.json -print -quit)
          test -n "$RESULT"
          BUNDLE=$(dirname "$RESULT")
          echo "TRAINING_BUNDLE=$BUNDLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          python - "$RESULT" <<'PY'
          import json, sys
          result = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))
          assert result["config"]["datasetVersion"] == "matrix.nlu.dataset.v2"
          assert result["config"]["model"]["variant"] == "student-4-v2"
          assert result["studentLayers"] == 4
          assert result["frozenDataRead"] is False
          assert result["trainingSplitsRead"] == ["train", "dev"]
          PY
      - name: Install pinned evaluation and export dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --requirement matrix_nlu/requirements-train.txt
      - name: Run hardened audit dev frozen export and package gates
        run: >-
          python auto_test.py
          --bundle "$TRAINING_BUNDLE"
          --output-dir build/matrix-nlu/student-4-v2-hardened-gates
          --candidate-role counter-review
          --data-dir build/matrix-nlu/data-v2
          --onnx-repetitions 30
      - name: Record source run resource and checksum evidence
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OUT=build/matrix-nlu/student-4-v2-hardened-gates
          mkdir -p "$OUT"
          printf 'SOURCE_TRAINING_RUN=%s\n' "${SOURCE_TRAINING_RUN:-UNRESOLVED}" \
            | tee "$OUT/source-run.txt"
          df -h . | tee "$OUT/disk.txt"
          free -h | tee "$OUT/memory.txt"
          find "$OUT" -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 \
            | sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum > "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"
      - name: Upload hardened gate evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: matrix-nlu-student-4-v2-hardened-gates-${{ github.run_id }}
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 6
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            build/matrix-nlu/student-4-v2-hardened-gates/
            build/matrix-nlu/automation/auto-test-status.json
      - name: Upload verified counter-review package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: success()
        with:
          name: matrix-nlu-student-4-v2-verified-${{ github.run_id }}
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 1
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: build/matrix-nlu/last-good-package-student-4-v2/

name: Matrix-NLU Student-4 V2 Checkpoint

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      resume_run_id:
        description: Optional prior Student-4-v2 run containing its resumable latest.pt
        required: false
        type: string
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pipeline/student-4-v2-retrain.trigger'

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  train-dev-frozen-export-package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      HF_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY: '1'
      TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM: 'false'
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: '4'
      MKL_NUM_THREADS: '4'
      MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR: build/matrix-nlu/training-student-4-v2
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: matrix_nlu/requirements-train.txt
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .cache/huggingface
          key: matrix-nlu-geotrend-36de33ec-v2
      - name: Install pinned train test and export dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --requirement matrix_nlu/requirements-train.txt
      - name: Restore an explicitly selected Student-4-v2 checkpoint
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.resume_run_id != ''
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SOURCE_RUN="${{ inputs.resume_run_id }}"
          [[ "$SOURCE_RUN" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
          mkdir -p resume-download report-download "$MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR/checkpoints"
          if ! gh run download "$SOURCE_RUN" \
            --name "matrix-nlu-student-4-v2-resume-$SOURCE_RUN" --dir resume-download; then
            gh run download "$SOURCE_RUN" --name "matrix-nlu-resume-$SOURCE_RUN" \
              --dir resume-download
          fi
          if ! gh run download "$SOURCE_RUN" \
            --name "matrix-nlu-student-4-v2-report-$SOURCE_RUN" --dir report-download; then
            gh run download "$SOURCE_RUN" --name "matrix-nlu-report-$SOURCE_RUN" \
              --dir report-download
          fi
          CHECKPOINT=$(find resume-download -type f -name latest.pt -print -quit)
          STATUS=$(find report-download -type f -name auto-train-student-4-v2-status.json -print -quit)
          AUDIT=$(find report-download -type f -name dataset-v2-audit.json -print -quit)
          test -n "$CHECKPOINT"
          test -n "$STATUS"
          test -n "$AUDIT"
          cp "$CHECKPOINT" "$MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR/checkpoints/latest.pt"
          python - "$SOURCE_RUN" "$CHECKPOINT" "$STATUS" "$AUDIT" \
            "$MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR/resume-evidence.json" <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, pathlib, sys
          run_id, checkpoint, status_path, audit_path, output = sys.argv[1:]
          status = json.load(open(status_path, encoding="utf-8"))
          audit = json.load(open(audit_path, encoding="utf-8"))
          assert status["variant"] == "student-4-v2"
          assert status["datasetVersion"] == "v2"
          assert status["trainingDir"].endswith("training-student-4-v2")
          assert status["resumeCheckpointPreserved"] is True
          assert audit["status"] == "PASS"
          assert audit["frozenPredictionsRead"] is False
          digest = hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(checkpoint).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          evidence = {"schemaVersion": "matrix.nlu.resume-evidence.v1",
                      "sourceRunId": int(run_id), "checkpointSha256": digest,
                      "datasetVersion": "matrix.nlu.dataset.v2",
                      "variant": "student-4-v2", "studentLayers": 4,
                      "sourceAuditSha256": hashlib.sha256(
                          pathlib.Path(audit_path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
          pathlib.Path(output).write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2) + "\n")
          PY
          cp "$MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR/resume-evidence.json" \
            "$MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR/resume-source.txt"
      - name: Run audited Student-4-v2 checkpoint pipeline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          COMMAND=(python run_pipeline.py --dataset-version v2 --student-layers 4)
          if [[ -f "$MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR/resume-evidence.json" ]]; then
            COMMAND+=(--resume-evidence "$MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR/resume-evidence.json")
          fi
          "${COMMAND[@]}"
      - name: Record preserved evidence
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/matrix-nlu/automation
          find build/matrix-nlu -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 \
            | sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum > build/matrix-nlu/automation/SHA256SUMS
          df -h . | tee build/matrix-nlu/automation/disk.txt
          free -h | tee build/matrix-nlu/automation/memory.txt
      - name: Upload bounded Student-4-v2 report evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: matrix-nlu-student-4-v2-report-${{ github.run_id }}
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 6
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            build/matrix-nlu/automation/
            build/matrix-nlu/verification-training-student-4-v2/
            build/matrix-nlu/data-v2/*manifest.json
            build/matrix-nlu/data-v2/v1-to-v2-corrections.json
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/training-result.json
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/training-progress.json
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/labels.json
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/resume-source.txt
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/resume-evidence.json
      - name: Upload isolated Student-4-v2 model bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: matrix-nlu-student-4-v2-bundle-${{ github.run_id }}
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 1
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/training-result.json
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/labels.json
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/model-state.pt
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/tokenizer/
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/resume-evidence.json
      - name: Upload isolated Student-4-v2 resumable checkpoint
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: matrix-nlu-student-4-v2-resume-${{ github.run_id }}
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 1
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/checkpoints/latest.pt
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/resume-source.txt
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/resume-evidence.json

name: Matrix-NLU Student-4 V2.1 Post-Run Dev Gate

    env:
      HF_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY: '1'
      TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM: 'false'
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: '4'
      MKL_NUM_THREADS: '4'
      PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
      VERIFY_DIR: build/matrix-nlu/verification-training-student-4-v2.1-post
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: matrix_nlu/requirements-train.txt
      - name: Resolve preserved Student-4-v2.1 bundle
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "push" ]]; then
            SOURCE_RUN=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < pipeline/student-4-v21-post.trigger)
          else
            SOURCE_RUN="${{ inputs.training_run_id }}"
          fi
          [[ "$SOURCE_RUN" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
          echo "SOURCE_TRAINING_RUN=$SOURCE_RUN" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          gh run download "$SOURCE_RUN" --name "matrix-nlu-student-4-v21-bundle-$SOURCE_RUN" --dir downloaded
          RESULT=$(find downloaded -type f -name training-result.json -print -quit)
          test -n "$RESULT"
          BUNDLE=$(dirname "$RESULT")
          echo "TRAINING_BUNDLE=$BUNDLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          sha256sum "$BUNDLE"/training-result.json "$BUNDLE"/model-state.pt "$BUNDLE"/labels.json
      - name: Install pinned evaluation dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --requirement matrix_nlu/requirements-train.txt
      - name: Rebuild immutable v2 dev dataset
        run: python matrix_nlu/build_dataset_v2.py
      - name: Audit rebuilt dev dataset before evaluation
        run: >-
          python matrix_nlu/audit_dataset_v2.py
          --data-dir build/matrix-nlu/data-v2
          --output build/matrix-nlu/automation/dataset-v21-post-audit.json
          --fail-on-error
      - name: Evaluate development and controlled stop from preserved bundle
        run: >-
          python -m matrix_nlu.controlled_dev_v21
          --bundle "$TRAINING_BUNDLE"
          --data-dir build/matrix-nlu/data-v2
          --output-dir "$VERIFY_DIR"
      - name: Record post-run evidence
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |

.github/workflows/matrix-nlu-train.yml.content:
name: Matrix-NLU One-Click Pipeline

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      student_layers:
        description: Student encoder layers; leave empty for teacher evidence
        required: false
        default: '4'
        type: string
      resume_run_id:
        description: Optional prior one-click run containing a resumable latest.pt
        required: false
        type: string
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'pipeline/student-4.trigger'

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  train-test-package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      HF_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY: '1'
      TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM: 'false'
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: '4'
      MKL_NUM_THREADS: '4'
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: matrix_nlu/requirements-train.txt
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .cache/huggingface
          key: matrix-nlu-geotrend-36de33ec-v1
      - name: Install pinned train/test/export dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --requirement matrix_nlu/requirements-train.txt
      - name: Resolve isolated variant output
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "push" ]]; then
            LAYERS=4
          else
            LAYERS="${{ inputs.student_layers }}"
          fi
          if [[ -n "$LAYERS" ]]; then
            [[ "$LAYERS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
            echo "MATRIX_NLU_STUDENT_LAYERS=$LAYERS" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR=build/matrix-nlu/training-student-$LAYERS" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          else
            echo "MATRIX_NLU_STUDENT_LAYERS=" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR=build/matrix-nlu/training" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi
      - name: Restore an explicitly selected resumable checkpoint
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.resume_run_id != ''
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p resume-download "$MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR/checkpoints"
          gh run download "${{ inputs.resume_run_id }}" --dir resume-download
          CHECKPOINT=$(find resume-download -type f -name latest.pt -print -quit)
          test -n "$CHECKPOINT"
          cp "$CHECKPOINT" "$MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR/checkpoints/latest.pt"
          printf 'resumeRunId=%s\ncheckpointSha256=' "${{ inputs.resume_run_id }}" \
            > "$MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR/resume-source.txt"
          sha256sum "$MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR/checkpoints/latest.pt" \
            | awk '{print $1}' >> "$MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR/resume-source.txt"
      - name: Run strict prepare train-resume validate frozen export package pipeline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          COMMAND=(python run_pipeline.py)
          if [[ -n "$MATRIX_NLU_STUDENT_LAYERS" ]]; then
            COMMAND+=(--student-layers "$MATRIX_NLU_STUDENT_LAYERS")
          fi
          "${COMMAND[@]}"
      - name: Record preserved evidence
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/matrix-nlu/automation
          find build/matrix-nlu -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 \
            | sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum > build/matrix-nlu/automation/SHA256SUMS
          df -h . | tee build/matrix-nlu/automation/disk.txt
          free -h | tee build/matrix-nlu/automation/memory.txt
      - name: Upload bounded report evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: matrix-nlu-report-${{ github.run_id }}
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 6
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            build/matrix-nlu/automation/
            build/matrix-nlu/verification-*/
            build/matrix-nlu/data/*manifest.json
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/training-result.json
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/training-progress.json
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/labels.json
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/resume-source.txt
      - name: Upload deployable model bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: matrix-nlu-bundle-${{ github.run_id }}
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 1
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/training-result.json
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/labels.json
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/model-state.pt
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/tokenizer/
      - name: Upload isolated resumable checkpoint
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: matrix-nlu-resume-${{ github.run_id }}
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 1
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/checkpoints/latest.pt
            ${{ env.MATRIX_NLU_TRAINING_DIR }}/resume-source.txt

.github/workflows/p0.yml.content:
name: P0 Understanding Lab

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  baseline:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.11.1'
      - name: Unit tests
        run: gradle --no-daemon :core:test
      - name: Clean Italian trainer
        run: gradle --no-daemon :trainer:test :trainer:trainItalianClean
      - name: Unified A/B benchmark
        run: gradle --no-daemon :cli:run
      - name: Expanded pre-fix P0.5 baseline
        run: gradle --no-daemon :cli:p05Baseline
      - name: Build Android footprint probe
        run: gradle --no-daemon :android-probe:assembleDebug
      - name: Verify offline Android artifact
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=android-probe/build/outputs/apk/debug/android-probe-debug.apk
          test -s "$APK"
          PERMISSIONS=$("$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/build-tools/35.0.0/aapt" dump permissions "$APK")
          echo "$PERMISSIONS"
          if grep -q 'android.permission.INTERNET' <<<"$PERMISSIONS"; then
            echo 'Unexpected INTERNET permission in offline probe' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          stat -c 'APK_BYTES=%s' "$APK"
          sha256sum "$APK"
          unzip -l "$APK" | awk '/opennlp-.*-pos-.*\.bin$/ { total += $1 } END { print "MODEL_BYTES_UNCOMPRESSED=" total }'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: p0-results
          path: build/results/
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: p05-training
          path: build/p05/
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: p05-baseline
          path: build/p05-baseline/
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: p0-android-probe
          path: android-probe/build/outputs/apk/debug/android-probe-debug.apk
